test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The __________ scheme, that covers artisans related to 18 fields, was included under the 'Payments Infrastructure Development Fund' (PIDF) scheme by the Reserve Bank of India in October 2023.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**PM Vishwakarma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Vishwakarma** is a scheme launched by the **Government of India** to support traditional artisans and craftsmen.
 
• This scheme covers artisans related to **18 traditional fields**, including carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, cobblers, tailors, and potters.
 
• The scheme aims to promote the skills of these artisans and provide them with financial assistance, tools, and marketing support.
 
• In **October 2023**, the Reserve Bank of India included this scheme under the **Payments Infrastructure Development Fund (PIDF)** to strengthen its implementation and outreach.
 
• The initiative also focuses on enhancing the quality of products, enabling artisans to compete in local and international markets.
 
• Under this scheme, artisans receive benefits such as **subsidized loans, skill development training, and business support.**
 
• The scheme aligns with the vision of recognizing and preserving India’s rich cultural heritage and traditional craftsmanship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PM USHA**__

 __
 
• **PM USHA** scheme is a fictional option in this context and does not relate to any existing government initiative.
 
 
 
• **PM Ullas**__
 __
 
• **PM Ullas** is a fictional term and does not correspond to any recognized government program.
 
 
 
• **PM Swanidhi**__
 
 
• **PM Swanidhi** is a scheme launched by the **Government of India** to provide **financial assistance to street vendors.**
 
• This scheme offers **working capital loans** to street vendors to help them recover from the effects of the **COVID-19 pandemic.**
 
• It is focused on creating opportunities for **self-employment and entrepreneurship** for urban street vendors.
